turning_points.text: lost the family farm to a bad winter
walked home alone after the flood
travelled three seasons with a trader and came back changed
carried a letter across the sea
swore to own the best workshop in the village
learned a second trade at night to get ahead
buried a brother who never came back from the mines
lost a best friend to a quarrel and never made it right
swore the lanterns hummed on the night of their birth
found a stone that is always warm

wants: a way to repay an old debt
word from a sibling far away
a better tool for the trade
a safe road to the next village
a feast the whole village remembers
someone to take over the trade
hooks: Sometimes wakes from a dream of a gate that is not there.
Has a book full of glyphs nobody can read.
Listens for a distant voice at dusk and will not say whose it is.
